messages.en:
I know this isn't like me,{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0a 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 14 00} but how does
this sound?
{07 14 00}You and me get together
and go fossil hunting
sometime, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Tean, pole minu moodi,{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0a 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 14 00} aga kuidas
see kõlab?
{07 14 00}Sina ja mina saame kokku
ja läheme fossiile
jahtima, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{01 08 00}{07 02 00}STOP!{01 01 00} Don't even think about
taking up a hobby! It's way
too dangerous!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 16 00}Once you start fossil
hunting, it'll take over
your life, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{01 08 00}{07 02 00}STOPP!{01 01 00} Ära isegi mõtle
hobi võtmisele! See on
liiga ohtlik!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 16 00}Kui sa hakkad fossiile
jahtima, võtab see su elu
üle, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Fossils! {01 00 00 05 00}Sweet fossils...{01 00 00 05 00}
Where are you, my precious
little stone bones?
{07 10 00}Why can't I find them?!
{07 05 00}Why do they mock me?!
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Fossiilid! {01 00 00 05 00}Armsad kondid...{01 00 00 05 00}
Kus te olete, mu kallid
väikesed kivikondid?
{07 10 00}Miks ma neid ei leia?!
{07 05 00}Miks nad mind pilkavad?!
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
I never find fossils. Why do
they hide from me?! I just 
know they're giggling at me.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 06 00}I'll find one even if I have 
to tear up the town with a
tractor, {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Ma ei leia kunagi fossiile.
Miks nad peidavad end?! 
Ma tean, et nad itsitavad.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 06 00}Ma leian ühe, kui pean 
või linna traktoriga
üles kündma, {04 02 00}!

messages.en:
I thought that if I used 
this old tool I'd find a 
fossil fast, {04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}It's already {04 08 00}:{04 09 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 06 00}And I've got nothing.
{01 00 00 0a 00}NOTHING!
messages.et:
Ma arvasin, et kui kasutan 
seda vana tööriista, leian 
fossiili ruttu, {04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}On juba {04 08 00}:{04 09 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 06 00}Ja mul pole midagi.
{01 00 00 0a 00}MITTE MIDAGI!

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} it's the
perfect day for fossil
hunting!
{07 17 00}Quit being so shy!{01 00 00 0f 00} Just
follow me, all right,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 0d 00}Together, we might find
some answers hidden in
these solid chunks of time!
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} täna on
täiuslik päev fossiilide
jahtimiseks!
{07 17 00}Lõpeta häbelikkus!{01 00 00 0f 00} Lihtsalt
järgne mulle, eks,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 0d 00}Koos võime leida vastuseid,
mis on peidus nendes
tahketes ajatükkides!

messages.en:
Yep. I'm hunting for fossils
without an umbrella. In the
pouring rain. {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 09 00}Whoop-dee-doo.
messages.et:
Jah. Ma jahin fossiile ilma
vihmavarjuta. Kallavas
vihmas. {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 09 00}Vuhh-dii-duu.

messages.en:
{07 15 00}I don't care how cold or
rainy it gets out here,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}I'm not giving up until I 
find a fossil tooth bigger
than my head!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Mind ei huvita, kui külm
või vihmane siin on,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}Ma ei anna alla, kuni leian 
fossiilse hamba, mis on
suurem kui mu pea!

messages.en:
{07 0f 00}Maybe I live a sad and 
lonely existence, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
But it would be nice to
have someone to hunt
fossils with.
Too bad there's no room
for anyone else to live
in my house{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 17 00}Man.{01 00 00 14 00} I wish I had a pad like
yours, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0f 00}Ehk elan ma kurba ja 
üksildast elu, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Aga oleks kena, kui
oleks keegi, kellega koos
fossiile jahtida.
Kahju, et mu majas pole
ruumi kellelegi teisele
elamiseks{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 17 00}Poiss.{01 00 00 14 00} Tahaks hurtsikut
nagu sul, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} I am so
jealous! {0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!!!

{07 14 00}You've got roommates to
help you find fossils,{01 00 00 05 00}
but I have to kick it solo. 
{07 0e 00}Of course{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{01 01 00} {07 03 00}I could never
live with someone like you!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} Ma olen nii
kade! {0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!!!

{07 14 00}Sul on toakaaslased, kes
aitavad fossiile leida,{01 00 00 05 00}
aga mina rassin üksi. 
{07 0e 00}Muidugi{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{01 01 00} {07 03 00}Ma ei suudaks
kunagi sinusugusega elada!

messages.en:
You know, my grandpappy
was a really famous 
paleontologist.{01 00 00 05 00}
He found all kinds of
rare bones, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 19 00}'Course, he had this weird
habit of snacking on dirt, 
so that might have helped.
messages.et:
Tead, mu vanaisa oli
tõeliselt kuulus 
paleontoloog.{01 00 00 05 00}
Ta leidis igasuguseid
haruldasi konte, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 19 00}Muidugi oli tal see veider
komme mulda nosida, 
nii et ehk see aitas.

messages.en:
{07 11 00}I know you're after my
fossils.{01 00 00 05 00} Oh, yes...
I know all about your plan.{01 00 00 05 00}
Don't think I haven't seen
you stare and wring your 
hands, {01 00 00 05 00}hatching a plot!
Well, your plot to steal my
precious beast relics has
been FOILED, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 11 00}Ma tean, et sa jahid mu
fossiile.{01 00 00 05 00} Oh jaa...
Ma tean su plaanist kõike.{01 00 00 05 00}
Ära arva, et ma ei näinud,
kuidas sa jõllitad ja käsi 
hõõrud, {01 00 00 05 00}plaani haududes!
Noh, su plaan mu kallid
koletisejäänused varastada
on NURJATUD, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I'm so happy that you 
traveled to see our fine
town.
Make yourself comfortable.
Kick back and enjoy your 
stay, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}But don't even think about
digging up fossils!{01 01 00}
They're mine! ALL MINE!!!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma olen nii rõõmus, et sa 
reisisid meie kena linna
vaatama.
Tunne end mugavalt.
Lõõgastu ja naudi oma 
viibimist, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}Aga ära isegi mõtle
fossiilide kaevamisele!{01 01 00}
Need on minu! KÕIK MINU!!!
